title: Compact-support automorphism actions commute with base change
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], where Noetherian means admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings. Supply a compactification $c=(j,r)$ with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $r$ proper [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. Work in the ordinary derived categories $D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with compact-support direct image [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and the compactification-independent exchange of [thm-cbc-finite-torsion]. Let $a:X\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ satisfy $fa=f$, let $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and supply an isomorphism $\theta:a^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}K$. The square with upper arrow $a$, lower arrow $1_Y$, and both vertical arrows $f$ is Cartesian: its comparison to $X\times_Y Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is $(a,f)$. Let $E_a(K):Rf_!K\to Rf_!a^*K$ be its exchange, using this comparison and the canonical compactification comparisons. Then
$$\rho_{a,\theta}=Rf_!(\theta)\circ E_a(K)$$
is an automorphism independent of the compactification representative. For $a=1_X$ and $\theta=1_K$, under the canonical identity pullback identification, $\rho_{1,1}=1$.

More precisely, for any morphism $u:T\to Y$ with $T$ Noetherian, put $X_T=X\times_Y T$, $f_T:X_T\to T$, $u':X_T\to X$, $a_T=a\times_Y1_T$, and $K_T=u'^*K$, and supply a compactification of $f_T$ with quasi-compact open part (the base-changed $c$ is allowed). Let $\theta_T:a_T^*K_T\xrightarrow{\sim}K_T$ be $u'^*\theta$ under the inverse-image composition comparison induced by $u'a_T=au'$. For the canonical compact-support exchange $C_u(K):u^*Rf_!K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{T!}K_T$, the actual morphisms satisfy
$$C_u(K)\circ u^*\rho_{a,\theta}=\rho_{a_T,\theta_T}\circ C_u(K).$$
This equality uses the same canonical comparisons even when the chosen compactification on $X_T$ differs from the pullback compactification.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1 and 2: auxiliary coherence statement making the compact-support action and its pullback precise; not a verbatim theorem of the blueprint

proof.text: The square with top map $a$, bottom map $1_Y$, and vertical map $f$ is cartesian. In the fibre product $X\times_Y Y$, the comparison map is $(a,f)$ by the universal property [def-pc-fibre-product]. Since $a$ is an isomorphism and $fa=f$, the map $a^{-1}$ composed with the first projection is an inverse comparison; the two composites are identities because their projections agree. Thus the compact-support square required by [def-cbc-compact-support-square] is the stated square.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1: the Cartesian square for the automorphism and its base-change comparison

proof.text: Apply [thm-cbc-finite-torsion] to this cartesian square, the finite ring $A$, the supplied compactification $c$, and the bounded-below object $K$. It gives an isomorphism $E_a(K):Rf_!K\to Rf_!a^*K$ after the canonical identification of the lower base with $Y$, and says that this exchange is natural in $K$ and independent of the compactification representative. By the compact-support definition [def-amb-etale-compact-support], $Rf_!$ is a functor on the ordinary derived category, so the coefficient isomorphism $\theta:a^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ induces $Rf_!(\theta)$. The composite $\rho_{a,\theta}=Rf_!(\theta)\circ E_a(K)$ is therefore an automorphism. It does not depend on the compactification representative: $E_a(K)$ does not by [thm-cbc-finite-torsion], and $Rf_!(\theta)$ does not because the proper-refinement comparisons identifying the chosen-compactification candidates are natural isomorphisms on $D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] (its hypotheses hold: $A$ is finite, $X,Y$ are Noetherian, and $f$ is separated of finite type with the compactification $c$), so they carry $Rf_!^{c}(\theta)$ to $Rf_!^{c''}(\theta)$ for any other compactification $c''$.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1: functoriality of compact supports gives the automorphism over the base

proof.text: For $a=1_X$ and $\theta=1_K$, the identity clause of [thm-cbc-finite-torsion] identifies the exchange with the identity after the canonical identity-pullback comparison. The functoriality in [def-amb-etale-compact-support] sends $1_K$ to $1_{Rf_!K}$, so the composite is $\rho_{1,1}=1$.

Use the supplied compactifications directly and the canonical comparison from the twice-pulled-back compactification to any supplied target [def-cbc-compact-support-square] and [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. Separatedness, locally finite type and quasi-compactness of the base-changed morphism follow from [lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change] and [lem-pc-quasi-compact-base-change]. No Noetherianity assertion about its source is needed for the formal coherence. The universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] gives u' a_T = a u'. Apply the horizontal-pasting law of [thm-cbc-finite-torsion] twice, first to the automorphism square followed by the base-change square, and then in the opposite order. Both outer rectangles coincide. The identity-pullback laws and sqIso, expressed as the quotient of the two pullback composition comparisons, identify these equations. Naturality of exchange at theta and functoriality of the compact-support direct image [def-amb-etale-compact-support] then give the required action equation. All comparison, pasting and naturality manipulations are proved for an abstract CompactSupportFormalism and then specialized to the ordinary etale derived formalism.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1 and 2: pull back the compact-support action and compare the coefficient isomorphism

proof.text: The exchange maps and the comparison $C_u$ in the preceding step are the canonical compactification-independent maps of [thm-cbc-finite-torsion]. That theorem states compatibility with the canonical comparisons for refinements and independence of the common refinement, so replacing the base-changed compactification by any supplied compactification on $X_T$ transports both sides using the same canonical source and target comparisons; these comparisons are natural in the coefficient object [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons], so they also commute with $F_T(\theta_T)$ and $F_T(\delta)$. Hence the displayed equality is the equality of the actual morphisms specified in the statement, even when the chosen compactification on $X_T$ differs from the pullback one.

split_report.summary: Expanded the auxiliary coherence statement into five proof steps. The first checks the Cartesian model of an automorphism square from the fibre-product universal property; the remaining steps apply finite-coefficient compact-support base change for the action, its identity case, naturality and pasting under arbitrary base change, and compactification independence. No new nodes were needed. Resumed the earlier sandbox, corrected the ill-typed pasting equation by explicitly naming its target comparison D, fixed doubled TeX escapes, and checked base-changed geometric hypotheses using existing nodes.

The coefficient category is the same throughout: ordinary étale D^+ with a finite commutative ring A, in the item, the parent, thm-cbc-finite-torsion and def-cbc-exchange-map. The base-change map is the exchange map of def-cbc-exchange-map (Rp_*j_! form), made compactification-independent as in thm-cbc-finite-torsion; no pro-étale coefficients are identified with it. All hypotheses of the theorem hold, and the statement is unchanged and not weakened. Step 1: elementary and correct; (a,f) has inverse a^{-1}pr_1 because fa^{-1}=f. Step 4: I recomputed it. Pasting the a-square with the u-square in either order gives the same Cartesian square with top au'=u'a_T, which yields D∘u^*E_a=E_{a_T}∘C_u with δ the quotient of the two associativity isomorphisms. Naturality of C_u applied to θ, using θ_T∘δ=u'^*θ, gives C_u∘u^*F(θ)=F_T(θ_T)∘D, and the three-term chain is correct. Edge cases checked: f=1 (forces a=1, ρ=θ), the fold map Y⊔Y→Y with the swap, empty X, and the parent's d=0 and identity-section cases. No new nodes, no duplicate found in the DAG, no cycle, no SGA. (1) C4/C1, steps 2 and 5: the statement's claim that ρ is independent of the compactification needs the refinement comparisons to be natural in K, so that Rf_!(θ), F_T(θ_T) and F_T(δ) are carried along. thm-cbc-finite-torsion covers only the exchange map, and def-amb-etale-compact-support defers this property. Added [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]: same unit sk-prop-sf-cbc, so on route, and its hypotheses are met. (2) C1, step 4: the pullback compactification must have a quasi-compact open part to be an allowed compactification and to apply the theorem. lean.statement: theorem compactSupportActionBaseChange (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f) [QuasiCompact c.i] (a : X ≅ X) (ha : a.hom ≫ f = f) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (theta : ((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).pb a.hom).obj K ≅ K) : IsIso (compactSupportAction A c (compactSupportActionSquare f a ha) K theta) ∧ (∀ (d : Compactification f) [QuasiCompact d.i], compactSupportAction A c (compactSupportActionSquare f a ha) K theta ≫ ((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).shriekIso c d).hom.app K = ((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).shriekIso c d).hom.app K ≫ compactSupportAction A d (compactSupportActionSquare f a ha) K theta) ∧ (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (u : T ⟶ Y) (d : Compactification (pullback.snd f u)) [QuasiCompact d.i], ((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).pb u).map (compactSupportAction A c (compactSupportActionSquare f a ha) K theta) ≫ (compactSupportActionExchange A (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f u) c d).app K = (compactSupportActionExchange A (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f u) c d).app K ≫ compactSupportAction A d (compactSupportActionSquare (pullback.snd f u) (compactSupportActionPullback f a ha u) (by simp [compactSupportActionPullback, pullback.map])) (((derivedPlusFormalism (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)).pb (pullback.fst f u)).obj K) (compactSupportActionPullbackCoefficient A f a ha u K theta))
